map.HV = 0.1865·HRC² − 1.455·HRC + 156.7（HRC: HV = 0.1865·HRC² − 1.455·HRC + 156.7 (HRC to Vickers fit, valid for HRC 20-67); when the input scale is HV, HRC is back-solved with the quadratic formula (−b+√(b²−4ac)) ÷ (2a), then HV is refreshed by forward substitution; if back-solving fails, HV keeps the input value. Validation: missing values count as 0. Criteria: back-solved HRC must fall in [20,67], out-of-range yields NaN, and HRC/HBW/HV are output together.

When the input system is HBW, HRC is solved by (−b+√(b²−4ac)) ÷ (2a); no real root or out-of-range input produces no number. When the input system is HV, HBW = 0.9544·HV (approximate conversion). When the input system is HV, HRC is solved by (−b+√(b²−4ac)) ÷ (2a) and the HV output is the input value; when the input is HBW, HV = HBW ÷ 0.9544. Interpretation: a solved HRC outside [20,67] shows "outside fit range" and no NaN is output.
